0022600086.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, and the Bucks are on the road at Washington. Milwaukee's Jericho Sims and Nate Ament are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Washington's Jamir Watkins and Tristan Vukcevic are out and AJ Dybantsa is day-to-day with a game-time decision. In the 2025-26 season series, the Bucks lost 1-3, including a 109-99 loss in Washington on January 29, 2026.
